common.tagline: Our family's recipes, carefully kept and easy to find.

unavailable.title: Can't reach the server
unavailable.body: Please try again in a moment.

setup.intro: Set up the family cookbook. Whoever sets it up becomes its owner and can then invite the family.
setup.alreadySetUp: The family cookbook is already set up.

errors.invalid_input: Check the email address and use a password of 8 to 128 characters.
errors.invalid_code: The setup code is not correct.
errors.already_set_up: The cookbook has already been set up by someone else.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.error: Setup could not be completed. Please try again.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.forgotHelp: Can't remember your password? Ask the cookbook owner to remove your access and invite you again. If you are the owner, contact the person who runs the site.

errors.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.noAccess: This account no longer has access to the cookbook.
errors.error: Could not sign in. Please try again.

recipes.empty: There are no recipes in this cookbook yet.

form.title: Title
form.ingredientsHint: One ingredient per line, written as in the recipe.

errors.title: Enter a title of up to 300 characters.
errors.ingredients: Use at most 200 ingredients of up to 500 characters each.
errors.steps: Use at most 100 steps of up to 4000 characters each.
errors.error: The recipe could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this recipe while you were editing it. Your changes are still in the form but were not saved.

members.heading: Members
members.invitesIntro: Create an invite link and share it with a relative, for example on WhatsApp. No email is sent.
members.labelHint: For example: Aunt Rosa. Only the owner sees this name.
members.linkNote: This link works once and expires after 7 days. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
members.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
members.noInvites: You have not created any invites yet.
members.revokeConfirm: Revoke this invite? The link will stop working.
members.forgotPasswordNote: If a member forgets their password, remove their access and send them a new invite. They can then create a new account with the same email.

removal.heading: Remove access for {email}
removal.intro: Before removing access, decide what happens to each recipe this person added. This list is shown only now.
removal.noRecipes: This person has not added any recipes.
removal.confirmNote: {email} will lose access to the cookbook immediately. Recipes marked for removal are deleted and cannot be restored.

errors.label: Use a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.create: The link could not be created. Please try again.
errors.revoke: The invite could not be revoked. Please try again.
errors.remove: Access could not be removed. Please try again.

join.heading: Join the family cookbook
join.intro: You have been invited to the family cookbook. Create your account to join.
join.emailNote: Your email is only used to sign in. We will never send you anything.
join.invalid: This invite is no longer valid — ask the owner for a new link.
join.signedInAs: You are signed in as {email}. Sign out to use this invite.

errors.invalid_input: Check the email address and use a password of 8 to 128 characters.
errors.invalid_invite: This invite is no longer valid — ask the owner for a new link.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with it or ask the owner for help.
errors.error: The account could not be created. Please try again.
errors.signed_in: Sign out of the current account before using this invite.

offline.clearFailed: Saved recipes could not be cleared. Please try again.
